llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must derive an explicit dirty state for the edit form (for example comparing current input vs last saved value) and only block leaving when that state is dirty.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: hasUnsavedChanges is derived by comparing name !== savedName and is kept in sync via useFocusEffect; the Alert is only shown when hasUnsavedChanges is true.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must intercept native-stack back/remove actions with `usePreventRemove(...)` on the edit screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: usePreventRemove is never imported or called anywhere in the submitted code; native back gestures and hardware back are not intercepted.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must show an explicit confirmation choice when leaving with unsaved changes and resume on confirm (for example by dispatching `data.action`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The Alert 'Leave' action calls navigation.goBack() directly rather than dispatching data.action (the prevented navigation action), which is required when using usePreventRemove to resume the original back action.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must allow leaving the edit screen without a confirmation prompt when there are no unsaved changes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When hasUnsavedChanges is false, handleBack calls navigation.goBack() immediately without showing an Alert.
